English.Char_Desc_45: Simple video player for folders of videos
English.Char_Desc_80: Plays MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV and more, a whole folder at a time, with big buttons.
English.Char_Desc_250: A simple video player with big worded buttons. Opening one video lines up the rest of its folder. Play/Pause, skip 10 seconds, Previous/Next, volume, full screen, and Save frame to keep the picture on screen as a PNG.
English.Char_Desc_450: A simple video player with big worded buttons. Opening one video lines up the rest of its folder. Play/Pause, skip 10 seconds, Previous/Next, volume, full screen, and Save frame to keep the picture on screen as a PNG. Free. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; nothing else to install.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Video Player plays MP4, MKV, WebM, AVI, MOV, WMV, FLV, MPG, M4V, 3GP, TS and OGV videos, with their sound. Opening one video lines up the other videos in the same folder after it, so Next always has somewhere to go; opening several videos or a whole folder plays just those, in name order. Videos can also be dragged onto the window. Buttons: Open videos, Open folder, Previous, Back 10 s, Play/Pause, Forward 10 s, Next, Save frame (pauses and saves the picture on screen as a PNG), mute, volume, Full screen and List. Keys: Space, the arrow keys, P and N, F, S and M. When a video ends, the next one starts; a video that can't be played is marked and skipped. Everything it needs is included.
Before you install: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Video Player is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Video Player is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
